items.headline: Linux - Why does llama.cpp ROCm consume SO much VRAM for KV cache compared to Vulkan?
items.summary: I have a docker stack with a bunch of AI services and llama.cpp server is the brain. I've got a working vulkan yml snippet for llama.cpp but out of curiosity, I flipped it to ROCM (latest build) and did not see ANY performance improvement.
